messages.content: A workbook is attached to this task. Its sheet `stock` has the columns sku, region and units, one row per sku. Find the single row whose sku is exactly SKU-000372 and report that row's region and units. Do not compute anything and do not summarise the sheet; read the one row. Answer with ONLY this JSON, nothing else: {"region": "<region>", "units": <integer>}
